scripts.dev: npm run prepare:web && vite apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:web: npm run prepare:web && npm run typecheck:web && vite build apps/web --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:web: node --experimental-strip-types --test apps/web/tests/runner.test.ts apps/web/tests/bytes.test.ts && playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/web/src/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "apps/web/tests/*.ts" "apps/web/*.ts" apps/web/index.html apps/web/tsconfig.json scripts/prepare-web.mjs scripts/check-wasm-bridge.mjs scripts/capture-rpc.mjs package.json
